units.source_text: 我做了这样一个梦：岸边有条小路，

en.t: I had this dream: there was a little path along the shore,

units.source_text: 盛开的夹竹桃将枝丫伸展到湛蓝的海面上，

en.t: and blooming oleanders stretched their branches out over the deep blue sea,

units.source_text: 路上还立着一个白色的木制路标，

en.t: and on the road there also stood a white wooden signpost,

units.source_text: 透过树梢可以望见烟云。

en.t: through the treetops, misty clouds could be seen.

units.source_text: 在这条小路上，我遇见了一位青年，

en.t: On that little path, I met a young man,

units.source_text: 他身穿飞行服般的服装，手戴皮手套，

en.t: he was wearing clothes like a flight suit and leather gloves on his hands,

units.source_text: 眉毛浓密，笑时左唇微微上翘。

en.t: his eyebrows were thick, and when he smiled the left side of his lip lifted slightly.

units.source_text: 我们走了一段路，我心中涌起了一股爱恋之情。

en.t: After we had walked for a while, a feeling of love welled up in my heart.

units.source_text: 我苏醒过来，心想：是不是要同空军军官结婚呢？

en.t: I woke up and thought: am I going to marry an air force officer?

units.source_text: 我对这个梦久久不能忘怀。

en.t: For a long time, I could not forget that dream.

units.source_text: 我还清楚地记得，靠岸行驶的轮船是“第五绿丸”。

en.t: I also remember clearly that the ship traveling close to shore was the Fifth Midori Maru.
